title: Landing page hero
description: The public home page of Riaya. A doctor reads what the platform does and can start signing up or look at how it works.

title: Pricing section, Free and Pro
description: The two plans side by side: Free at no cost and Pro at 49 TND per month. A doctor compares limits such as WhatsApp sends, recording hours and assistant questions before choosing.

title: Doctor sign-up form
description: The account creation page with email and password. A new doctor registers here and then continues to the verification and application steps.

title: Doctor application under review
description: The profile page of a doctor whose application is still pending. The doctor fills in identity, speciality and cabinet details and uploads the identity card and council certificate, then waits for an administrator.

title: Patient review page
description: The page a patient opens from the WhatsApp link sent two hours after the visit. It shows the doctor, speciality, date and practice of the visit, then the patient gives a star rating, the waiting time and an optional comment, without any account.

title: Doctor dashboard with plan usage
description: The home page of a doctor with counters for patients, appointments and invoices, a 14-day chart and the monthly meters for WhatsApp sends, recording time and the AI assistant.

title: Appointments calendar
description: The weekly calendar of the doctor. Confirmed bookings are green, pending requests are amber and an urgent request is red; the doctor can also drag to create or move appointments.

title: Accepting or refusing a booking
description: Opening a pending request shows the patient details and the reason given on the phone. The doctor can accept it, which creates the patient file, or refuse it, which triggers a callback to the patient.

title: Weekly availability
description: The page where the doctor sets working hours for each day. The best-fit search only offers slots that fall inside these hours.

title: Patients list
description: The list of patients of the doctor with their CIN, name and date of birth. From here the doctor opens a file or adds a patient by hand.

title: Patient file with history
description: One patient file with identity details, the history of consultations, prescriptions and lab reports, a recording with its consultation note, and the invoices. The doctor adds medical files and sends them by WhatsApp from here.

title: Invoices list
description: All invoices with number, patient, total, amount paid and status. The doctor sends an invoice by WhatsApp or records a payment.

title: Editing an invoice
description: The invoice dialog with its line items and notes. The doctor changes quantities and prices and the total updates before saving.

title: Recordings list
description: The consultations recorded by the doctor with their transcription status, and a panel to start a new recording. The remaining recording hours of the month are shown under the record button.

title: Recording with consultation note
description: A transcribed consultation with the audio player and the structured note generated by the AI. The doctor can edit the note or regenerate it.

title: Transcript with speaker roles
description: The lower part of the same recording, with the transcript split by speaker and timestamp. The doctor can assign who is the doctor and who is the patient.

title: AI assistant with a proposed action
description: A conversation with the doctor assistant about pending bookings. The assistant proposes accepting a booking and the doctor confirms or dismisses the action card.

title: Team and secretary invitations
description: The page where a Pro doctor invites secretaries by email and removes them. It lists the active secretary and the pending invitation with its expiry date.

title: Subscription and monthly usage
description: The usage meters for recording time, WhatsApp sends and the AI assistant, a button to add recording hours, and the billing invoices paid through Konnect.

title: Secretary dashboard
description: The dashboard seen by a secretary. The menu only has patients, appointments, invoices and availability, with no recordings, assistant or billing.

title: Administrator dashboard
description: The home page of the administrator with user counters and the list of doctor accounts waiting for review. The side menu gives access to applications, best fit, calls, reports and settings.

title: Doctor application review
description: A pending application with identity card, council certificate, cabinet details and location on a map. The administrator approves or rejects the doctor.

title: Best fit finder, calendar view
description: A tool to test the doctor matching for a speciality and a patient city. The calendar shows how many doctors have a free slot at each time and which ones.

title: Best fit finder, map view
description: The same search on a map, with the patient in red and the matching doctors around the city. Nearby doctors are grouped in clusters.

title: Calls list with live transcript
description: The list of calls with the active one on top, and the transcript of a selected call on the right. It shows what the AI and the caller said and the tool calls such as the urgent booking.

title: Reported call under review
description: A call the AI reported for insults, with the reason, the transcript and the report_abuse tool call. The administrator dismisses the report or blocks the number.

title: Blocked numbers
description: The numbers rejected before the AI answers, with the block end date, the note and how many calls were refused. The administrator can also block a number by hand.

title: Test call and model settings
description: The page used to simulate a call without a phone. The panel on the right lets the developer pick the realtime model and the caller transcription model for the test.

title: Doctor ratings
description: The administrator's list of rated doctors with average, 90-day average, review count and long waits. Doctors under 3 stars over at least 5 reviews are highlighted.

title: Reviews of one doctor
description: The reviews of one doctor with rating, waiting time, visit and comment, and the button to stop referrals.

title: Stopping referrals
description: The dialog where the administrator writes the reason the doctor will read before referrals stop.

title: Referral exclusion banner
description: The doctor dashboard while the doctor is excluded from referrals, with the administrator's reason and the support address.
